user.title: Idegis / AstralPool cloud-MITM receiver
user.description: This Home Assistant instance will run its own receiver for the chlorinator's cloud protocol. Prerequisite (done once, outside HA): your LAN's DNS override / reverse proxy for api.idegis.net must forward to this instance's HTTP port, at /api/idegis_astralpool/interface/read.php and write.php. See docs/06-installation-and-lan.md in the repository.

init.title: Idegis / AstralPool — alerts
init.description: Pick which conditions should raise an alert, and the notify.* service to send it to (e.g. notify.telegram_jarvis, notify.mobile_app_phone). Leave notify_service empty to disable dispatch while still seeing warnings in the log.

data.ph_enabled: Alert on pH out of range
data.salinity_enabled: Alert on salinity out of range
data.session_stale_enabled: Alert when the chlorinator stops reporting
